buyer_added_terms.text: Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Procurement of Semi Automated Urine Analyser with 5 Years Warranty by Direct Purchase through GeM Additional Special Terms and Conditions 1. The Bidders are advised to study carefully the various clauses contained in the Terms and conditions bef ore submitting their tender bids. The tenders shall be in two bids, technical and Price bids. Only the vendor s who qualified in the technical bid shall be qualified for Price bid. 2. If any information is found incorrect or misleading at a later date the firm would be rejected and would r ender it ineligible to participate in any future tendering. 3. The contract will be valid for a period of one year from the date of commencement of contract unless sh ort closed before date by The DDG/DFUKN or CMO I/C OFHOEFC. TECHNICAL BID: 2. The bidder will submit the following documents for Technical Bid:- a. Latest GST Registration Certificate & PAN. Bidders who are not registered with GST Authorities will not b e considered. b. The bidder should be from any state/UT of India with at least 03 years experience, The proof of experie nce should be submitted. c. Past Experience of Similar Services- Supply of Medical Equipment: Experience of having successfully co mpleted similar works during last 7 year ending last day of month previous to the opening of technical are i nvited should be either of the following: (i) Three similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to 40% of the estimated cos t. (ii) Two similar completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to 50% of the estimated cost . (iii) One similar completed work costing not less than the amount equal to 80% of the estimated cost. d. EMD is not applicable as per GeM Rules Bid Value Below Rs 5 Lakh(if applicable). e. The bidder should submit copy of OEM or Dealership issued by the OEM of Semi Automated Urine Analys er. f. OEM/Authorized Service Centre should have service support in Kanpur Nagar, supporting Document sho uld be submitted by the bidder. g. Exemption of Experience & Turnover for startup/MSME firms will be applicable as per MSME L/No. 1(2)(1 )/2016-MA Dated 10March2-16 & L/No. F.20/2/2014 PPD (PT), Dated 25/07/2016. g. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS: Technical Specifications for Semi Automated Urine Analyser No. 196/31/OFHOEFC/MS(NE)/SAUA/26-27 Sl. No. Parameter Required Specification 1 Type of analyser Semi-automated urine chemistry strip reader 2 Measurement principle Reflectance photometry 3 Detection system CCD/optical colour detection with LED illumination 4 Throughput Up to 400 tests/hour or higher 5 Parameters SG, LEU, NIT, pH, PRO, GLU, KET, UBG, BIL, BLD, ASC, Colour and Clarity 6 Measurement Semi-quantitative urine chemistry analysis 7 User interface Colour touchscreen 8 Display 800 × 480 pixel colour touch screen 9 Sample identification Manual entry, barcode reader and worklist 10 Strip recognition Automatic/user-selectable strip identification 11 Test strips Compatible with urine chemistry strips 12 Result output Direct display and printed report 13 Built-in printer Thermal printer 14 Data memory Minim 1,000 results 15 User-defined settings Yes 16 Measurement units SI, conventional and arbitrary units 17 Interface RS-232 serial port, Ethernet, PS/2 and 2 × USB Data Management and Display Sl. No. Requirement Specification 18 Display Colour touchscreen, 800 × 480 pixels or higher 19 Result storage Minimum 1,000 results 20 Patient/sample ID Manual entry and barcode reader 21 Worklist Yes 22 Result printing Built-in thermal printer

23 Computer interface RS-232 and Ethernet 24 USB connectivity 2 × USB ports 25 External keyboard PS/2 interface 26 Data units SI, conventional and arbitrary 27 LIS connectivity Interface/connectivity provision available Power Requirements Sl. No. Requirement Specification 28 Power supply 100–240 V AC 29 Frequency 50–60 Hz 30 DC requirement 7.5 V, 5.34 A 31 UPS Suitable UPS to be provided 32 Recommended UPS backup Minimum 30 minutes 33 Operating temperature 15–35°C 34 Relative humidity 20–80% Accessories, Spare Parts and Consumables The following should be included with the equipment: 35 Semi Automated urine chemistry analyzer – 1 No. 36 Compatible urine reagent strips. 37 Quality-control material. 38 Control/check strips, where applicable. 39 Thermal printer paper/rolls. 40 Barcode reader. 41 Power adapter and connecting cables. 42 User/technical/maintenance manual. 43 Necessary installation accessories. 44 Adequate quantity of consumables for initial operation. 45 All standard accessories required for complete functioning of the equipment. 46 Certification: Compliance with applicable Medical Device Rules/IVD regulatory requirements in India o r latest ISO 13485 certification. 47 Warranty: Minimum 5 years from the date of successful installation/acceptance of the equipment, incl uding parts, labour and service, excluding consumables. (The warranty should cover (Electronic componen ts, Optical system,Touchscreen/display, Printer , Barcode reader supplied with the equipment, Power suppl y, Necessary replacement parts, Preventive maintenance and breakdown service) Miscellaneous Requirements 48 OEM/ authorized supplier shall ensure availability of spares for at least 10 years. 49 OEM/authorized service center should have service support in Kanpur Nagar. 50 Installation and commissioning shall be provided at site. 51 Complete demonstration and user training shall be provided. 52 User, service and maintenance manuals shall be supplied in hard and soft copy. 53 Technical support should be available through telephone/email/toll-free facility. 54 Breakdown complaints should be attended within 48 hours. 55 Preventive maintenance should be carried out as per manufacturer's schedule. 56 Software updates, where applicable, should be provided during the warranty period. 57 The equipment should be supplied with all accessories necessary for operation. 58 The seller should provide a list of recommended spare parts and consumables with part numbers. 59 The supplier should provide installation/commissioning and training certificates. 60 The equipment should be compatible with the hospital's LIS where required. 61 The supplier should provide appropriate QC materials and demonstrate QC procedures. 62 The equipment should be new, unused and current production model. PRICE BID: 3. The acceptance of Price bid will normally be on the basis of maximum discount offered by the bidder on the MRP of the machine, subject to fulfillment of other conditions. Net Discount on Maximum Retail Price ( MRP) shall be the basis for determining the L1 bidder. 4. Total value wise evaluation and inbuilt “Reverse Auction” of GeM/ L1 negotiation will be exercised get maximum discount from L1 bidder. 100% of the Purchase Order Value will be placed on L1 bidder. 5. Installation: Installation and commissioning shall be provided at OFHOEFC. Complete demonstration and user training shall be provided by the supplier 6.Penalty: the penalty shall be as the clauses of GeM contract. In case of failure or refusal by local vendor t o supply the items to OFHOEFC, the contract is liable to be canceled at his risk and cost as per GeM Rules. . PAYMENT TERMS 7. Presentation of Bill: The contractor shall present the bill along with Job Completion Certificate issued by the hospital, OFHOEFC, Original Mandate form with cancelled cheque. 8. The contractor will be paid on M. R. P. less discount, other taxes as per applicable but no other Sales Ta

x, Octroi or any other levy/ tax will be paid which has to be borne by the Contractor. 23. The purchaser reserves the right to demand in any case, the original invoices for verification of genuin eness of source. ARBITRATION 24. All questions, disputes or differences arising out of or in connection with the contract, if concluded shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the court within the local limits whose jurisdiction the place from which the acceptance of tender is issued is situated. i.e. Kanpur. This contract shall be governed by t he subject to and interpreted and construed in accordance with the Laws of the Republic of India, as may b e in force from time to time. .
